tags.selectRemote.en: Remote to compare local Tags against
tags.selectRemote.zh-CN: 选择本地标签的比较远端

tags.scope.en: Local Tags · status compares the selected remote's read address
tags.scope.zh-CN: 本地标签 · 状态对应所选远端的读取地址

tags.syncedHint.en: {{remote}}: the local and remote Tag objects match

tags.localHint.en: {{remote}}: this Tag is absent from the remote

tags.differentHint.en: {{remote}}: the same Tag name has a different object

tags.unknownHint.en: {{remote}}: remote status has not been verified

tags.separatePush.en: Read and push addresses differ; this status describes the read address
tags.separatePush.zh-CN: 读取与推送地址不同；此状态描述读取地址

tags.commitLegend.en: Commit availability on known remote branches; Tag status is shown on each Tag label
tags.commitLegend.zh-CN: 提交在已知远端分支上的状态；标签状态单独显示在各标签上

tags.remoteChanged.en: The remote address changed. Refresh the repository and check again.
tags.remoteChanged.zh-CN: 远端地址已变更，请刷新仓库后重新核对。

tags.unavailable.en: Remote Tag queries are unavailable. Reload the workbench after updating the extension.
tags.unavailable.zh-CN: 远端标签查询不可用，请更新扩展后重新加载工作台。
